products.name: Overnight Air Cargo Services
products.description: Operation of feeder airline cargo routes under contract, primarily for FedEx, using company-provided crew and operational control, with aircraft provided by FedEx. Services include daily small-package cargo flights and maintenance of aircraft.

products.name: Ground Support Equipment
products.description: Manufacture, sale, and servicing of mobile aircraft deicers, scissor lifts, decontamination units, tow tractors, glycol recovery vehicles, and other specialized ground support equipment for airlines, airports, military, and industrial customers. Products are engineered and assembled using sourced components.

products.name: Commercial Aircraft, Engines and Parts Solutions
products.description: Acquisition, trading, leasing, and disassembly of commercial aircraft and jet engines; sale and procurement of surplus and aftermarket parts; provision of overhaul, repair, and maintenance services; and aircraft storage and part-out services. Delivered through multiple subsidiaries with FAA/EASA certifications.

products.name: Digital Aviation Solutions
products.description: Development and provision of cloud-based software and data services for the aviation industry, including air cargo market data aggregation and ERP/MRO and RFQ automation software for aviation aftermarket businesses. Delivered as recurring subscription services via digital platforms.

products.name: Consumer Payment Products (Credit, Debit, Prepaid)
products.description: Visa provides a range of Visa-branded credit, debit, and prepaid payment products and digital credentials, issued by financial institutions and partners, enabling consumers and businesses to make purchases and access funds globally. These products are delivered through physical cards and digital platforms, leveraging VisaNet for secure transaction processing.

products.name: Payment Transaction Processing Services
products.description: Visa operates a global transaction processing network (VisaNet) that provides authorization, clearing, and settlement services for payment transactions, supporting both Visa-branded and non-Visa-branded cards, as well as digital wallets and accounts. These services are delivered via a secure, proprietary infrastructure across more than 200 countries and territories.

products.name: Commercial Payment Solutions
products.description: Visa offers a suite of commercial payment solutions for businesses and governments, including small business cards, corporate cards, purchasing cards, virtual cards, and digital payment credentials, designed to manage working capital, automate payments, and support expense management. These solutions are delivered through partnerships with financial institutions and embedded finance capabilities.

products.name: Money Movement and Remittance Services (Visa Direct)
products.description: Visa Direct is a global money movement platform enabling real-time domestic and cross-border payments, including P2P, B2C, B2B, and G2C flows, through cards, bank accounts, and digital wallets. The service leverages Visa’s network and acquired assets to facilitate fund transfers, payouts, and settlements across billions of endpoints.

products.name: Value-Added Services (VAS)
products.description: Visa provides a comprehensive suite of value-added services to clients, including issuing solutions (loyalty, benefits, BNPL, digital enablement), acceptance solutions (gateway, fraud prevention, dispute management), risk and security solutions (AI-driven fraud detection, authentication, cybersecurity), and advisory and analytics services. These are delivered as modular, cloud-based, and API-driven offerings.

products.name: Open Banking and Account-to-Account (A2A) Payment Solutions
products.description: Through platforms like Tink, Visa offers open banking solutions enabling secure data exchange, account verification, balance checks, personal finance management, and A2A payment initiation. These services are delivered via APIs and partnerships with banks and fintechs, supporting both data access and payment flows.

products.name: Stablecoin and Crypto Payment Solutions
products.description: Visa provides infrastructure and services for stablecoin and crypto payments, including on-ramp/off-ramp platforms for buying, spending, and settling crypto assets, as well as enabling banks to issue and manage stablecoins. These offerings leverage Visa’s network and tokenization technology to facilitate cross-border and emerging market payments.

products.name: Agentic and AI-Driven Commerce Solutions
products.description: Visa offers agentic commerce solutions integrating tokenization, authentication, and AI-powered personalization to enable secure, automated, and personalized commerce experiences. These are delivered via APIs and developer tools for partners to deploy agent-driven transactions and intelligent payment processing.

products.name: Industrial Process Fluids
products.description: Formulated specialty chemical fluids used in heavy industrial and manufacturing applications, including steel, aluminum, automotive, aerospace, can, mining, and metalworking industries. These fluids are produced through chemical formulation and are delivered directly to customer manufacturing sites.

products.name: Metal Removal Fluids
products.description: Specialty chemical fluids designed for metal cutting, grinding, and machining processes, produced through proprietary chemical formulations and supplied to industrial customers for use in manufacturing operations.

products.name: Rolling Lubricants
products.description: Chemical lubricants formulated for use in the rolling of steel and aluminum, manufactured in specialized facilities and delivered to customers in the metals industry to optimize rolling processes.

products.name: Hydraulic Fluids
products.description: Specialty fluids formulated for hydraulic systems in industrial equipment, produced through chemical blending and supplied to manufacturing and heavy industry customers.

products.name: Surface Treatment Solutions
products.description: Chemicals and solutions for surface treatment and plating, including cleaning, corrosion protection, and plating chemicals, produced in chemical manufacturing plants and delivered to automotive and industrial customers.

products.name: Specialty Greases and High-Performance Lubricants
products.description: Greases and lubricants, including first-fill and high-performance types, formulated for use in automotive, aerospace, electronics, and industrial applications, produced in specialized facilities and supplied to OEMs and manufacturers.

products.name: Chemical Management Services (FluidcareTM)
products.description: On-site chemical management services, including supply, monitoring, and optimization of process fluids for industrial customers, delivered through dedicated personnel and proprietary service programs.

products.name: Impregnation Treatment Products and Services
products.description: Products and services for impregnation treatment used in automotive and other industries to optimize production processes, involving specialized chemical formulations and on-site service delivery.

products.name: Lubricant Additives
products.description: Highly formulated chemical solutions manufactured and blended to enhance the performance, efficiency, and durability of lubricating oils for vehicles and industrial machinery. Delivered as additive packages or components to oil companies and blenders worldwide.

products.name: Fuel Additives
products.description: Chemical compounds produced to improve oil refining processes and the performance of gasoline, diesel, biofuels, and other fuels. Products are sold globally to fuel marketers, refiners, and blenders, and are designed to meet stringent industry and customer requirements.

products.name: Antiknock Compounds
products.description: Chemical additives, primarily tetraethyl lead, marketed in North America to improve the octane rating of gasoline. Manufactured and sold to fuel producers and blenders, with operations focused on terminal and contracted manufacturing services.

products.name: Specialty Perchlorates
products.description: Manufactured ammonium, sodium, and potassium perchlorates used primarily as oxidizers in solid rocket motors, missiles, and space launch vehicles, as well as in munitions, explosives, electronics, and other industrial applications. Produced in the U.S. and supplied to government and commercial customers globally.

products.name: High-Purity Hydrazine Products
products.description: Ultra Pure® and high-purity hydrazine chemicals produced for use as propellants and monopropellants in satellite, aerospace, and defense propulsion systems. Manufactured to stringent purity standards and supplied to government and commercial aerospace customers.

products.name: Calix One Platform
products.description: An integrated broadband delivery platform combining agentic AI, cloud-based SaaS applications, intelligent appliances, and software to enable communication service providers to build and manage next-generation networks and deliver subscriber experiences. Delivered as a combination of hardware, software, and cloud services.

products.name: Calix Cloud SaaS Applications
products.description: Role-based cloud software applications (Engagement Cloud, Operations Cloud, Service Cloud) providing real-time data, analytics, and automation for marketing, operations, and customer support teams of service providers. Delivered as SaaS.

products.name: Calix Agent Workforce
products.description: A suite of AI-powered digital agents (Service, Subscriber, Operations, Marketing Agents) that automate and optimize customer service, marketing, and network operations for service providers. Delivered as part of the platform and cloud services.

products.name: Access Edge Network Solutions
products.description: Automated, intelligent access network and subscriber service management solutions (including E-Series modular systems) for deploying and managing next-generation broadband networks. Delivered as physical network equipment with integrated software.

products.name: Experience Edge Premises Solutions
products.description: Premises Wi-Fi and service delivery solutions (including GigaSpire and GigaPro Wi-Fi appliances) for managed subscriber services in homes, businesses, and communities. Delivered as hardware appliances with integrated software.

products.name: SmartLife Managed Services
products.description: A portfolio of managed services built on the Calix One platform, including SmartHome, SmartTown, SmartBiz, and SmartMDU, providing managed Wi-Fi, security, productivity, and connectivity solutions for residential, business, community, and multi-dwelling unit subscribers. Delivered as recurring managed services integrated with hardware and cloud.

products.name: Calix Success Services
products.description: Professional and customer success services supporting service providers in strategy, technology implementation, operations optimization, and deployment of new subscriber services. Delivered as consulting, training, and support services.

products.name: Fresh Chicken Products
products.description: Refrigerated or frozen whole or cut-up chicken, breast fillets, mini breast fillets, and prepackaged case-ready chicken, produced through vertically integrated farming, processing, and distribution operations.

products.name: Prepared and Value-Added Meat Products
products.description: Portion-controlled, breaded, marinated, or fully/partially cooked chicken and pork products, including nuggets, patties, sausages, bacon, deli meats, salads, and coated foods, produced in prepared foods cook plants and distributed refrigerated or frozen.

products.name: Fresh Pork and Lamb Products
products.description: Primary pork cuts, added value pork, pork ribs, and lamb products, produced and processed in the U.K. and Europe, distributed fresh or frozen to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Exported Meat Products
products.description: Whole chickens, chicken parts, pork cuts, hog heads, and trotters sold refrigerated or frozen for export markets, leveraging international distribution networks.

products.name: Live Chicken Sales (Mexico)
products.description: Live chickens sold primarily in the Mexican market, sourced from vertically integrated operations and distributed to local customers.

products.name: Industrial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of single-tenant and multi-tenant industrial properties, including distribution centers, warehouses, light industrial, and small bay industrial properties, to external tenants. Properties are owned, managed, and maintained by the company, requiring physical real estate assets and in-person property management.

products.name: Joint Venture Industrial Property Management Services
products.description: Provision of property management and related services to joint ventures in which the company holds an equity interest, generating management fee income and potential profit-sharing. Services involve in-person management and oversight of industrial real estate assets owned by the joint venture.

products.name: Efzofitimod
products.description: Efzofitimod is a novel biologic immunomodulator, a fusion protein derived from histidyl-tRNA synthetase, produced via recombinant E. coli expression and administered intravenously. It is being developed for the treatment of interstitial lung diseases (ILDs), including pulmonary sarcoidosis and systemic sclerosis-associated ILD, and potentially other immune-mediated fibrotic and inflammatory diseases.

products.name: tRNA Synthetase-Derived Biologic Therapeutics Pipeline (including ATYR0101 and ATYR0750)
products.description: A pipeline of biologic drug candidates derived from domains of human tRNA synthetases, produced using recombinant protein technology. These candidates, such as ATYR0101 (targeting fibrotic diseases via selective elimination of myofibroblasts) and ATYR0750 (a novel ligand for FGFR4 for inflammation and fibrosis), are in preclinical development for the treatment of various fibrotic and inflammatory diseases.

products.name: Search Platform (Digital Advertising)
products.description: A suite of browser add-ons, desktop and mobile apps, and software tools that automate, optimize, and monetize digital advertising campaigns by referring user search traffic to major search engines. Delivered digitally, these products require ongoing software development, campaign management, and integration with search engines and advertisers.

products.name: Quantum Technology Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of quantum computing, sensing, navigation, and security solutions, including quantum error correction, quantum-enhanced algorithms for biomedical research, quantum gyroscope sensors, quantum-based cybersecurity, quantum timing systems, and quantum-centric supercomputing. These are developed through specialized subsidiaries and delivered as proprietary software, hardware, and IP to enterprise, government, and research customers.

products.name: Enterprise AI Writing Assistance Tools
products.description: AI-powered writing assistance software, primarily the 'Bubbl' product, which leverages artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural language processing to provide personalized, human-like text generation and translation for business, medical, academic, and blogging applications. Delivered as a digital subscription service to businesses and individuals.

products.name: Precision Aerospace and Defense Components and Assemblies
products.description: Manufacture and supply of high-precision components and assemblies such as landing gears, flight controls, engine mounts, and jet engine parts for military and commercial aircraft, as well as ground turbines. Production is performed in-house at U.S.-based manufacturing centers, requiring advanced machining, quality control, and adherence to stringent regulatory standards.

products.name: Special Mission Aviation Solutions (pending merger)
products.description: Provision of special mission aviation solutions, including aircraft sourcing, financing, modification, and aviation services such as pilots, maintenance, and program support, primarily for government customers. This business line is delivered through a combination of asset management, technical modification, and operational support services.

products.name: Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS)
products.description: An autonomous system for detecting, tracking, and neutralizing aerial threats using AI-driven sensors and effectors. Manufactured as deployable hardware with embedded software, delivered to defense customers for integration into air defense operations.

products.name: Multi-Purpose Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS)
products.description: Versatile unmanned aerial vehicles configurable for reconnaissance, perimeter protection, and search-and-rescue, featuring modular payloads and powered by proprietary AI autonomy. Delivered as physical drone platforms with software, manufactured and customized per customer order.

products.name: Vision-AI Technology
products.description: Bio-inspired, pixel-level visual processing technology for real-time, low-light, and object recognition applications, delivered as embedded software or integrated hardware modules for cross-domain use in defense and industrial systems.

products.name: Vision-RF Imaging System
products.description: A patented system converting radio frequency signals into 2D/3D video feeds for surveillance in indoor, underwater, or subterranean environments, delivered as hardware modules with proprietary software for integration into defense and security platforms.

products.name: High-Resolution Radar System
products.description: Real-time radar systems for threat detection and tracking of dynamic objects, designed for integration with active protection or weapon systems, delivered as physical radar units with supporting software for defense and security applications.

products.name: Remote Weapon Station (RWS)
products.description: Stabilized, high-elevation weapon platforms for vehicles or naval vessels, featuring precision targeting and AI-assisted fire control, delivered as manufactured hardware with integrated software for defense customers.

products.name: Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV)
products.description: Stealthy, low-noise robotic ground vehicles for special forces, law enforcement, or medical evacuation, featuring swarm coordination via proprietary AI, delivered as manufactured robotic platforms with embedded autonomy software.

products.name: Active Protection System (APS)
products.description: Modular, solid-state defense systems for vehicles, designed to intercept and neutralize short-range threats such as drones and anti-tank munitions, delivered as hardware modules with integrated AI for vehicle-agnostic deployment.

products.name: Technology Licensing and Co-Development Services
products.description: Licensing of proprietary AI, sensing, and autonomy technologies to defense contractors and governments, as well as strategic alliances and joint ventures for co-development and large-scale manufacturing, delivered through contractual agreements and technology transfer.

products.name: Wnt Pathway Modulating Antibody Therapeutics for Retinal Diseases
products.description: Antibody-based therapeutics designed to selectively modulate the Wnt signaling pathway for the treatment of serious retinal diseases such as diabetic macular edema (DME), wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD), and uveitic macular edema (UME). These are manufactured using proprietary SWAP technology to create multi-specific, manufacturable antibodies delivered via intravitreal injection.

products.name: Wnt Pathway Modulating Antibody Therapeutics for Corneal Diseases
products.description: Research-stage antibody therapeutics targeting the Wnt pathway for corneal endothelial diseases, aiming to enhance proliferation and wound healing of corneal endothelial cells. These are developed using proprietary antibody engineering and are currently in preclinical evaluation.

products.name: Out-Licensed Fzd4 Bi-Specific Antibody Therapeutics for Retinal Diseases (SZN-413 and related)
products.description: Bi-specific antibody therapeutics targeting Fzd4, developed using SWAP technology, out-licensed to Boehringer Ingelheim for research, development, and commercialization in retinal vascular-associated diseases. These are manufactured as full-length human antibodies for intravitreal administration.

products.name: Aircraft Leasing
products.description: Leasing of modern, fuel-efficient commercial jet aircraft (primarily passenger aircraft) to airlines worldwide. Aircraft are purchased new from manufacturers or acquired via sale-leaseback or secondary market, and leased under long-term operating leases. Delivery, configuration, and ongoing management are handled by Air Lease Corporation, with lessees responsible for operation and maintenance.

products.name: Aircraft Sales and Trading
products.description: Sale of aircraft from the owned fleet to third parties, including other leasing companies, financial institutions, airlines, and investors. Aircraft are typically sold while on lease to maximize value, and sales may also occur opportunistically for trading profits.

products.name: Fleet Management Services
products.description: Provision of fleet management services to third-party investors and owners of aircraft portfolios for a management fee. Services include managing leases, maintenance, and remarketing of aircraft not owned by Air Lease Corporation.

products.name: Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) Therapy Devices
products.description: A portfolio of portable medical devices (Optune Gio, Optune Lua, Optune Pax, and pending Optune Mya) that deliver proprietary Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields)—low-intensity, alternating electric fields—via single-use arrays placed on the skin to treat various solid tumor cancers. Devices are manufactured using standard electronic medical device methodologies and distributed directly to patients or through hospitals, with ongoing technical and patient support.

products.name: Pressure-Sensitive Label Materials
products.description: Manufactured using papers, plastic films, and metal foils coated with adhesives and laminated with backing materials, these materials are sold in roll or sheet form for labeling, decorating, and specialty applications across various industries. Production requires physical manufacturing, materials science, and process engineering expertise.

products.name: Graphics and Reflective Materials
products.description: A range of engineered films and materials, including vinyl and specialty films, used for vehicle wraps, architectural applications, commercial signage, digital printing, and traffic safety. These products are physically manufactured and require specialized coating and laminating processes.

products.name: Performance Tapes and Bonding Materials
products.description: Pressure-sensitive adhesive-based tapes and bonding materials, including mechanical fasteners and performance polymers, used for non-mechanical fastening, bonding, and sealing in automotive, electronics, construction, and industrial sectors. Production involves physical manufacturing and precision molding.

products.name: RFID Inlays and Tags
products.description: Ultra-high-frequency RFID inlays and tags that enable digital identification and tracking of physical items, supporting supply chain efficiency, loss prevention, and item-level visibility. These are manufactured using advanced materials and electronics integration.

products.name: Branding and Embellishment Solutions
products.description: Custom brand embellishments, graphic tickets, tags, labels, and sustainable packaging designed to enhance product branding and consumer experience. These are produced through a combination of physical manufacturing, printing, and design processes.

products.name: Retail Media and Shelf-Edge Solutions
products.description: Shelf-edge productivity and media solutions, such as price ticketing, marking, and digital signage, primarily under the Vestcom® brand, delivered through a mix of physical and digital technologies to improve retail operations and shopper engagement.

products.name: Brand Protection and Security Solutions
products.description: Solutions for brand protection, security, and compliance, including care, content, and country of origin labeling, as well as anti-counterfeiting and traceability features. These are delivered through a combination of physical labels and digital data management.

products.name: E-commerce Inventory Funding and Management Solutions
products.description: Forever 8 provides funding solutions and inventory management services to e-commerce businesses, enabling sellers to maintain optimal stock levels without tying up their own capital. This service is delivered through financial capital deployment and inventory logistics management, rather than physical manufacturing.

products.name: Custom Corrugated Packaging Products (divested)
products.description: Through Ferguson Containers, the company manufactured and sold custom corrugated packaging for a wide variety of products, using physical manufacturing processes and recycled materials. Products were produced to order and shipped using company-owned trucks. This business was divested in April 2025.

products.name: Commercial Automobile Insurance
products.description: Provides bodily injury and property damage liability, uninsured motorist, and physical damage coverage for commercial accounts, including tailored coverage for state governments, municipalities, and large motor fleets. Delivered through underwriting, agent distribution, and regulated insurance contracts.

products.name: General Liability Insurance
products.description: Covers bodily injury and property damage liability for premises and completed operations exposures for general classes of business. Delivered via regulated insurance policies underwritten and distributed through agents.

products.name: Surety Bonds
products.description: Contracts guaranteeing fulfillment of obligations, such as subdivision construction, school bus contracts, and performance/payment bonds. Delivered as regulated insurance products to third parties, often for government or commercial contracts.

products.name: Inland Marine and Other Property Insurance
products.description: Provides coverage for property in transit and other specialized property risks, delivered through regulated insurance contracts. Includes 'other lines' such as inland marine coverage.

products.name: Life Insurance
products.description: Offers individual and group whole life and term life insurance policies with various riders and options, underwritten and delivered through agents. Requires actuarial and regulatory compliance, and is distributed both to individuals and employer groups.

products.name: Medicare Supplement Insurance
products.description: Provides standardized insurance plans covering expenses not paid by Medicare, such as copayments and deductibles. Delivered as regulated insurance products, primarily to seniors, and distributed through agents and brokers.

products.name: Other Supplemental Health Insurance
products.description: Includes accident, cancer, critical illness, hospital indemnity, short-term care, and disability insurance, offered as individual or group policies. Delivered through regulated insurance contracts, often to employer groups or individuals, and distributed via agents and brokers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to businesses, including commercial term loans, lines of credit, owner-occupied commercial real estate loans, and participation in syndicated loans. These are delivered through in-person relationship managers and require significant underwriting and risk management.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by non-owner occupied commercial real estate, multifamily properties, and construction/bridge loans for commercial and multifamily developments. These loans are physically underwritten, require collateral, and are sourced through loan officers and brokers.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides residential mortgage loans, including conforming and non-conforming loans, home equity lines of credit, and construction loans for single-family homes. Loans are originated through branches and loan officers, and may be held for investment or sold in the secondary market.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers unsecured consumer installment loans, personal reserve accounts (overdraft lines), and other personal credit products through the retail branch network. These are typically small, fixed-term or revolving loans underwritten based on creditworthiness.

products.name: Small Business and SBA Lending
products.description: Provides small business loans and lines of credit, including government-guaranteed SBA loans, primarily through the retail branch network. These loans are underwritten according to both bank and SBA guidelines and are designed to support local small businesses.

products.name: Private Banking Services
products.description: Delivers specialized lending and credit products (such as partner loans, personal lines of credit, and investment management lines of credit) and mortgage/HELOC products to high-net-worth individuals, often with customized terms and relationship-based pricing.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Offers a broad suite of FDIC-insured deposit accounts, including personal and business checking, savings, money market, IRAs, time certificates of deposit, and safe deposit boxes, delivered through a large branch network and digital channels.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides business clients with cash management solutions such as automated bill payments, remote and mobile deposit capture, ACH origination, wire transfers, lockbox, and liquidity management services. These are delivered digitally and through specialized teams.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers online and mobile banking platforms for both consumer and business clients, enabling account management, transaction processing, and access to other banking services 24/7 via digital channels.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Offers comprehensive wealth management, investment management, and trust services to individuals and businesses, typically involving in-person advisory and fiduciary services supported by specialized staff.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Sells insurance products to consumer clients, likely through partnerships or as an agent, delivered via branches and other channels.

products.name: Oral Bempedoic Acid Medicines (Monotherapy)
products.description: Oral, once-daily, non-statin small molecule drugs (bempedoic acid) manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as tablets to lower LDL-C and reduce cardiovascular risk in patients unable or unwilling to take statins. Commercialized as NEXLETOL (US), NILEMDO (Europe), and other brands internationally.

products.name: Oral Bempedoic Acid and Ezetimibe Combination Medicines
products.description: Oral, once-daily, fixed-dose combination tablets of bempedoic acid and ezetimibe, manufactured via chemical synthesis, designed to lower LDL-C and reduce cardiovascular risk through complementary mechanisms. Commercialized as NEXLIZET (US), NUSTENDI (Europe), and other brands internationally.

products.name: Bulk Tablets and Supply to Collaboration Partners
products.description: Manufacture and sale of bulk tablets (bempedoic acid and bempedoic acid/ezetimibe) to international collaboration partners for further commercialization in their respective territories. Products are manufactured under contract and supplied in bulk for local packaging and distribution.

products.name: Collaboration and Licensing Revenue (Out-Licensing of Commercial Rights)
products.description: Out-licensing of development and commercialization rights for bempedoic acid and bempedoic acid/ezetimibe products to partners in various international territories, generating revenue through upfront, milestone, and royalty payments. No physical product is delivered; revenue is based on contractual agreements.

products.name: Net-Leased Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of single-tenant office properties to corporate tenants on a net-lease basis, where tenants pay base rent and are responsible for most operating and maintenance costs. This is a physical real estate service requiring property ownership and management.

products.name: Global Money Transfer Services
products.description: Digital-first platform enabling customers to send money across borders via mobile app, website, or messaging services, with recipients able to receive funds through bank accounts, cash pick-up, or mobile wallets. The service is supported by a global network of funding and disbursement partners and is delivered entirely digitally without physical agent-based sending.

products.name: Cross-Border Business Payment Services
products.description: Digital cross-border payment solutions for small to mid-sized businesses, leveraging the same platform and network as consumer remittances, enabling businesses to send and receive international payments efficiently and securely.

products.name: Remitly Flex (Send Now, Pay Later)
products.description: A digital payment option allowing customers to send money internationally and pay later via a no-interest, flexible payment plan, integrated into the core money transfer platform.

products.name: Digital Wallet and Debit Card Services
products.description: Digital wallet (Remitly Wallet) enabling customers to store and save money, and a digital debit card (Remitly Card) for spending funds globally, both delivered through the Remitly platform and accessible via mobile devices.

products.name: Membership and Loyalty Programs
products.description: Membership and loyalty offerings (such as Remitly One) that provide a unified experience and rewards for engagement with Remitly’s suite of cross-border financial products, delivered digitally through the platform.

products.name: Halneuron (Tetrodotoxin-based Nav1.7 Modulator)
products.description: A proprietary, non-opioid analgesic drug candidate based on highly purified tetrodotoxin, developed for the treatment of chronic and acute pain disorders, especially chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain (CINP). It is manufactured via synthetic or natural extraction processes and delivered as a lyophilized injectable pharmaceutical product, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: SP16 (Synthetic Serpin Peptide)
products.description: A synthetic anti-inflammatory peptide drug candidate designed to replicate the cytoprotective and anti-inflammatory signaling of natural SERPINs, intended for the prevention and treatment of chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy. Manufactured via peptide synthesis and delivered intravenously, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: IMC-1 (Famciclovir + Celecoxib Combination Therapy)
products.description: A proprietary oral combination of famciclovir and celecoxib, developed as an antiviral therapy to suppress herpesvirus activation and replication, primarily targeting fibromyalgia and related chronic conditions. Manufactured by combining two approved drugs into a fixed-dose regimen, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: IMC-2 (Valacyclovir + Celecoxib Combination Therapy)
products.description: A proprietary oral combination of valacyclovir and celecoxib, developed as an antiviral therapy with specific activity against Epstein-Barr virus, intended for the treatment of Long-COVID symptoms. Manufactured by combining two approved drugs into a fixed-dose regimen, subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: Glass Containers for Alcoholic Beverages
products.description: Manufactured glass containers in various sizes, shapes, and colors for alcoholic beverages such as beer, wine, spirits, and flavored malt beverages, produced in large-scale glass manufacturing plants and delivered directly to beverage producers.

products.name: Glass Containers for Food and Non-Alcoholic Beverages
products.description: Manufactured glass packaging for food items, soft drinks, teas, and juices, produced in industrial glass plants and supplied to food and beverage manufacturers under supply agreements.

products.name: Glass Containers for Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Manufactured glass containers specifically designed for pharmaceutical products, produced in specialized glass manufacturing facilities and supplied to pharmaceutical companies.

products.name: Returnable/Refillable Glass Containers
products.description: Manufactured glass containers designed for return and refill cycles, supported by a large infrastructure for collection and redistribution, primarily in South America and Mexico.

products.name: Medium- to Large-Sized Projected Capacitive Touchscreens
products.description: Manufactured touchscreens ranging from 7.0 inch to 42-inch, using various structures (Glass-Glass, Glass-Film-Film, Plastic-Glass, Glass-Film), produced to order in company facilities and sold directly to customers in industries such as automotive, industrial HMI, POS, gaming, lottery, medical, and multi-functional printers. Production involves physical manufacturing, quality control, and compliance with international standards.

products.name: Cloud-Based Electronic Bill Payment Platform
products.description: A SaaS platform providing billers and financial institutions with integrated, omni-channel electronic bill presentment, payment processing, consumer engagement, and analytics. Delivered digitally via APIs, iFrames, or fully hosted solutions, it supports multiple payment types and channels, and is powered by AI/ML for automation and insights.

products.name: Instant Payment Network (IPN) Services
products.description: A proprietary network connecting billers, financial institutions, and partners (such as PayPal, retailers, and banks) to enable integrated, real-time electronic bill payment and presentment capabilities across partner platforms. Delivered via digital integrations and APIs.

products.name: Consumer Engagement and Communication Tools
products.description: Digital tools for billers and financial institutions to engage consumers with smart notifications, messaging, campaign management, and targeted communications across channels (email, text, IVR, chatbot). Delivered as part of the SaaS platform.

products.name: Electronic Bill Presentment Solutions
products.description: Omni-channel digital solutions for presenting bills to consumers via web, mobile, text, secure PDF, email, IVR, chatbot, social media, and partner platforms. Delivered through the cloud-based platform and integrated with client systems.

products.name: Omni-Channel Payment Processing Services
products.description: Secure, cloud-based payment processing supporting a wide range of payment types (ACH, credit/debit cards, digital wallets, emerging payment types) and channels (web, mobile, IVR, text, in-person, voice assistants, retail locations). Includes support for one-time, recurring, and scheduled payments.

products.name: Data Analytics and Insights Solutions
products.description: AI-powered analytics tools that provide billers and financial institutions with actionable insights on consumer behavior, payment trends, channel usage, and operational efficiency. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Integration Services for Core Systems
products.description: Digital integration services connecting the bill payment platform to clients’ core accounting, billing, CIS, ERP, and financial institution processing systems, enabling seamless data flow and automation. Delivered via APIs, SDKs, and pre-built connectors.

products.name: Packaging Systems
products.description: Specialty, highly engineered polymeric and steel closure and dispensing systems, including dispensing pumps, sprayers, caps, closures, flexible spouts, and jar products, manufactured using advanced injection molding and automated assembly for consumer, industrial, and life sciences markets.

products.name: Life Sciences Packaging and Components
products.description: Precision-engineered polymeric components and packaging for medical, pharmaceutical, and diagnostic applications, including airless dispensers, PCR test kits, vascular delivery components, and child-resistant closures, produced in clean-room environments with advanced manufacturing processes.

products.name: Steel Cylinders
products.description: High- and low-pressure forged steel cylinders for transportation, storage, and dispensing of packaged and compressed gases, manufactured using hot and cold forging and metalworking processes for industrial, healthcare, defense, and specialty gas markets.

products.name: Aerospace Fasteners and Components
products.description: Highly engineered fasteners, blind bolts, rivets, ducting, connectors, formed metal components, and assemblies for aerospace and defense applications, produced using customer-qualified and proprietary manufacturing processes for OEMs and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Online Dating Platforms

products.description: Organization and promotion of live events for singles, as well as access to date coaching services, offered through certain brands such as Match and Meetic. These services require in-person human labor and event management, supplementing the digital dating experience.

products.name: Automotive Paint and Surface Protection Films
products.description: Self-adhesive films designed to protect painted surfaces of automobiles and other surfaces, produced using roll-to-roll manufacturing and sold primarily through installers, dealerships, and OEMs.

products.name: Automotive Window Films (Tint)
products.description: Films applied to automotive glass to provide tinting and solar energy rejection, manufactured using roll-to-roll processes and sold under the XPEL PRIME brand through installers and dealerships.

products.name: Windshield Protection Film
products.description: Specialized film applied to the exterior of automotive windshields to increase impact resistance and prevent costly repairs, produced using film manufacturing processes.

products.name: Architectural Window Films
products.description: Films for commercial and residential building glass, including solar, safety & security, anti-graffiti, exterior, and decorative films, produced using roll-to-roll manufacturing and sold under the VISION brand.

products.name: Ceramic Coating
products.description: Hydrophobic, self-cleaning coating applied to automobiles, aircraft, and marine surfaces, delivered as a liquid product for professional or DIY application.

products.name: Pre-Cut Film Kits and Installation Tools
products.description: Pre-cut film kits, tools, accessories, and related merchandise for automotive and other surface protection applications, produced using proprietary software and film conversion operations.

products.name: Installation Services
products.description: Professional installation of protective films and coatings for automotive, architectural, and marine applications, delivered by trained technicians at company-owned centers, dealerships, or customer locations.

products.name: Design Access Platform (DAP) Software

products.name: Training Services

products.name: Measurement & Analytical Instrumentation
products.description: Produces intelligent instrumentation for measuring physical properties of liquids and gases, such as pressure, temperature, level, flow, acoustics, and more. These devices are manufactured hardware products that integrate with automation software and control systems.

products.name: Discrete Automation Solutions
products.description: Provides solenoid valves, pneumatic valves, actuators, electric linear motion solutions, programmable automation control systems and software, and materials joining solutions for discrete manufacturing industries. products.name: Safety & Productivity Tools
products.description: Delivers professional and homeowner tools including pipe-working tools, electrical tools, diagnostic systems, vacuums, and hand tools. These are physical products manufactured and distributed globally under various brands.

products.name: Control Systems & Industrial Software
products.description: Provides control systems and software for plant process automation, including distributed control systems, safety instrumented systems, SCADA, application software, digital twins, asset performance management, and cybersecurity. products.name: Asset Optimization Software (AspenTech)
products.description: Delivers asset optimization software that enables industrial manufacturers to design, operate, and maintain operations for maximum performance, leveraging advanced analytics, modeling, and simulation. This is a digital-only product line integrated into industrial operations.

products.name: Test & Measurement Systems
products.description: Provides software-connected automated test and measurement systems, including modular instrumentation, data acquisition and control solutions, and development software. These are hardware and software products used by enterprises to accelerate product development and reduce costs.

products.name: Digital Musculoskeletal (MSK) Care Platform
products.description: A software-led, AI-powered platform that delivers personalized, automated care for joint and muscle health, including exercise therapy, education, and care team support, accessible remotely via mobile devices. The platform covers a broad spectrum of MSK care, from acute injury to chronic pain and post-surgical rehabilitation, and is delivered digitally to members through partnerships with employers, health plans, and government entities.

products.name: Chronic Musculoskeletal Care Program
products.description: A core digital program focused on treating chronic musculoskeletal conditions across multiple body areas, combining AI-powered exercise therapy, educational content, and support from a multidisciplinary care team. Delivered remotely via the platform, it is the primary program for most members.

products.name: Acute Musculoskeletal Care Program
products.description: A digital program for short-term pain or one-time injuries, providing tailored exercise therapy and care team access, delivered remotely through the platform. Members can transition to the chronic program if pain persists.

products.name: Pre- and Post-Surgery MSK Care Program
products.description: A digital program supporting members before and after musculoskeletal surgery, offering exercise therapy, education, progress tracking, and care coordination with surgeons, delivered remotely via the platform.

products.name: Surgery Decision Support and High-Risk Member Program (HingeConnect)
products.description: A digital service using AI and data integration to identify high-risk members and provide targeted care support and decision support for those considering surgery, aiming to reduce unnecessary surgeries and costs. Delivered via the platform and integrated with external provider data.

products.name: Women's Pelvic Health and Menopause Program
products.description: A specialized digital program within the chronic care offering, addressing women's pelvic health needs (pregnancy, postpartum, bladder/bowel control, pelvic pain, pelvic strength) and menopause, with tailored exercise therapy and support from specialized care teams. Delivered remotely via the platform.

products.name: Fall Prevention Program
products.description: A digital program for adults aged 65 and older, focused on reducing fall risk through exercise therapy, education, and care team support, primarily offered to Medicare Advantage clients and available as modules to all members.

products.name: Prevention and Wellness Program
products.description: A digital program for members without MSK pain, offering exercise routines and education on sleep, stress management, nutrition, and movement, provided at no charge to clients and accessible via the platform.

products.name: Global MSK Care Program
products.description: A localized, digital MSK care program for international markets, providing personalized exercise therapy and education using AI-powered motion tracking, delivered without hardware or care team support to maximize scalability.

products.name: In-Person MSK Provider Network (HingeSelect)
products.description: A high-performance, in-person provider network for musculoskeletal care, offering triage, care navigation, and access to pre-vetted providers for imaging, injections, and other in-person services at reduced rates. Sold as an add-on to the digital platform.

products.name: Enso Electrical Nerve Stimulation Device
products.description: A proprietary, FDA-cleared wearable device delivering electrical nerve stimulation for non-addictive, non-invasive pain relief, integrated into core programs for high-risk members. Manufactured and distributed as a physical product.
